newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Gazprom intends to buy 25 pct of UES.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Gazprom intends to buy 25 pct of UES.

text.p: Russian gas monopoly RAO Gazprom intends to buy a stake of 25 percent plus one share in Russian national power company UES (Unified Energy System), Gazprom spokesman Anatoly Kotov said on Thursday.
Russia's Gazprom intends to buy 25 pct =2
RAO Yedinaya Energeticheskaya Sistema Rossii (UES) produces electric power from a variety of sources, including gas. It also owns large stakes in most of Russia's "energo" regional power utililies.
It is a major debtor of Gazprom, the world's biggest gas company.

The Russian government has said it wants to restructure both companies, which are Russia's two biggest corporations in terms of sales, and whose shares are two of the most actively traded stocks on the Russian equities market.
This is part of a general restructuring of the energy market to make costs more transparent, something sought by the International Monetary Fund.
